### :material-code-braces: Template variables

Variables you provide when running the template — `DATA_ROOT` via `--data-root`, the rest via `--var NAME=value`:

| Variable | Required | Description |
|---|:--:|---|
| `DATA_ROOT` | ✓ | Root directory of one nf-core/demultiplex run (the flowcell folders, multiqc/, pipeline_info/) |
| `METADATA_FILE` | — | Optional library metadata TSV. First column: the library name as written in the sample sheet; every other column (organism, input amount, project, ...) becomes a design column of the library hub. |
| `METADATA_ID_COL` | — | Metadata library-name column. Auto-detected as the first metadata column; defaults to 'sample'. |
| `GROUP_COL` | — | Metadata column the dashboards group and colour libraries by. Auto-detected as the first annotation column of METADATA_FILE; without metadata it falls back to a single group. |
| `IS_BCLCONVERT` | — | Set (--var IS_BCLCONVERT=true) for a run demultiplexed with --demultiplexer bclconvert: the run-level collections read the BCL Convert Reports/*.csv instead of the bcl2fastq Stats.json. Matches the run's params.json demultiplexer. |

**Auto-detected** (set from the run's metadata / `params.json`; the route flags drive *Conditional routes* below): `GROUP_COL_DISPLAY`

### :material-chef-hat: Recipes

Each recipe reshapes raw pipeline output into a tidy table. The name links to its source; *Output* lists the validated `EXPECTED_SCHEMA` columns.

| Recipe | Transforms | Output |
|---|---|---|
| [`bcl2fastq/demux_stats.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/bcl2fastq/demux_stats.py) | Reads per library and lane, with the undetermined reads, from bcl2fastq ``Stats.json``. | `flowcell`, `lane`, `lane_label`, `sample`, `index`, `is_undetermined`, `level`, `reads`, `pct_of_lane`, `yield_mb`, `pct_q30`, `mean_quality`, `pct_perfect_index`, `pct_one_mismatch_index` |
| [`bcl2fastq/lane_summary.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/bcl2fastq/lane_summary.py) | Run health per lane from bcl2fastq ``Stats.json``: clusters, yield, quality, balance. | `flowcell`, `lane`, `lane_label`, `clusters_raw`, `clusters_pf`, `pct_pf`, `yield_gb`, `pct_q30`, `mean_quality`, `n_libraries`, `library_reads`, `undetermined_reads`, `pct_undetermined`, `library_reads_cv`, `lowest_library_pct_of_mean` |
| [`bcl2fastq/read_quality.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/bcl2fastq/read_quality.py) | Base quality per lane and read from bcl2fastq ``Stats.json``. | `flowcell`, `lane`, `lane_label`, `read`, `read_label`, `yield_gb`, `pct_q30`, `frac_q30`, `mean_quality` |
| [`bcl2fastq/unknown_barcodes.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/bcl2fastq/unknown_barcodes.py) | Top unknown barcodes per lane, classed as likely index swaps, from bcl2fastq ``Stats.json``. | `flowcell`, `lane`, `lane_label`, `barcode`, `index1`, `index2`, `reads`, `rank`, `pct_of_lane`, `pct_of_undetermined`, `i7_in_use`, `i5_in_use`, `swap_class` |
